actions.description: Follow up directly with Rick Tanner's office about the Hawkins dealership disposition. At tick 10 I made first contact — introducing myself as the commercial agent who authored the auto row market brief and asking for fifteen minutes to discuss the disposition strategy for the closed location. This tick I secure that meeting or call. The Hawkins dealership is the largest commercial real estate event in Millfield this year: showroom build-out, service bay infrastructure, highway corridor visibility. The buyer categories I have been mapping since tick 0 — delivery logistics operators, EV fleet servicing, light industrial conversion — are precisely the categories this property fits. I do not pitch a listing on this call. I come with the market brief, three comparable buyer profiles I have already researched, and one ask: let me run the buyer-side market analysis for your disposition process. Earn the relationship before asking for the listing.
